name: First Contact
description: Make your first transaction on Peridot (supply, borrow, etc.).

name: Dual-State User
description: Have an active supply and an active borrow position simultaneously for at least 24 hours.

name: Polymath
description: Successfully perform all four core actions at least once: supply, borrow, repay, and withdraw.

name: Transactionist
description: Complete 5 total transactions.

name: First Watch
description: Connect your wallet on 2 separate days.

name: Three Day Vigil
description: Maintain any active position (supply or borrow) for 3 consecutive days.

name: Week of Service
description: Achieve a 7-day login streak.

name: Stalwart
description: Maintain a supply position of at least $100 for 10 consecutive days.

name: Sentinel
description: Maintain any active position for 14 consecutive days.

name: Loyal Sentinel
description: Achieve a 14-day login streak.

name: Peridot Knight
description: Achieve a 30-day login streak.

name: GM, Peridot
description: Achieve a 32-day login streak.

name: First Yield
description: Accrue at least $1 in total supply interest.

name: Market Participant
description: Reach a cumulative transaction volume of at least $500 (total supplied + borrowed).

name: Small Pusher
description: Reach a cumulative transaction volume of at least $2,000.

name: Stable Ground
description: Interact with two different stablecoins through supply or borrow actions (e.g., supply USDC and borrow USDT).

name: Into the Blue
description: Supply a volatile 'blue-chip' asset (e.g., ETH or WBTC).

name: Portfolio Explorer
description: Have active supply positions in three different assets simultaneously for at least 24 hours.

name: Borrow First
description: Borrow an asset for at least $10.

name: Borrow Zone
description: Borrow an asset for at least $50.

name: Yield Seeker
description: Achieve an effective APY of at least 5%.

name: Earnings Starter
description: Accrue at least $100 in total lifetime earnings.

name: Daily Earner
description: Achieve a daily average earnings of at least $5.

name: Journeyman
description: Finish 15 badges from the Bronze tier.

name: Master of Bronze
description: Finish 20 Badges from the Bronze tier.

name: First Jump
description: Complete your first cross-chain supply or borrow transaction.

name: Chain Explorer
description: Perform at least 10 cross-chain transactions.

name: In Transit
description: Achieve a cumulative cross-chain transaction volume of at least $5,000.

name: Silver Explorer
description: Have active supply positions in three different assets simultaneously for at least 24 hours min 100 USD per position.

name: Early Polymath
description: Perform a supply, borrow, repay, and redeem action.

name: Polymath
description: Complete 100 transactions.

name: Presence
description: Maintain any active position (min. value $250) for 14 consecutive days.

name: Seasoned Veteran
description: Connect your wallet on 30 separate days within the current season.

name: Vanguard
description: Maintain a position for 30 consecutive days (min. value $250), unlocking the 1.3x Continuity Bonus multiplier.

name: Heavy Lifter
description: Reach a cumulative transaction volume of at least $10,000.

name: Decisive Move
description: Perform a single supply or borrow transaction of at least $5,000.

name: Major Player
description: Reach a cumulative transaction volume of at least $50,000.

name: Quick Turnaround
description: Successfully repay a loan (min. $500) within 72 hours of opening it.

name: Yield Hunter
description: Achieve an effective APY of at least 10%.

name: Earnings Achiever
description: Accrue at least $1,000 in total lifetime earnings.

name: Consistent Earner
description: Achieve a daily average earnings of at least $25.

name: Silver Axe
description: Finish at least 35 Badges

name: Silvers Rayleigh
description: Finish all badges from the Silver tier.

name: 100 K
description: Reach a cumulative transaction volume of $100,000.

name: Quarter Million Club
description: Reach a cumulative transaction volume of $250,000.

name: Capital Commitment
description: Maintain a total supply value of at least $10,000 for 14 consecutive days.

name: Volumionaire
description: Reach a cumulative transaction volume of $1,000,000.

name: Conduit
description: Achieve a cumulative cross-chain transaction volume of $100,000.

name: Tri-Force
description: Maintain active supply positions on at least three different chains simultaneously for 7 consecutive days (min. total value $5,000).

name: Multichain Maestro
description: Successfully repay a cross-chain loan using a different asset than the one originally borrowed (min. loan value $2,500).

name: Daily Operator
description: Perform at least one on-chain transaction (supply, borrow, etc.) for 14 consecutive days.

name: Diamond Hands
description: Maintain any supply position (min. value $2,500) for 30 consecutive days.

name: Fixture of the Protocol
description: Have an active supply or borrow (min. value $2,500) position on 60 separate days within the current season.

name: Looper
description: Within a 24-hour period: Supply an asset, borrow a different asset against it, and use the borrowed funds to acquire and supply more of the original asset, increasing your initial supply position by at least $10,000 in the process.

name: Yield Master
description: Achieve an effective APY of at least 15%.

name: Earnings Champion
description: Accrue at least $5,000 in total lifetime earnings.

name: Professional Earner
description: Achieve a daily average earnings of at least $50.

name: Golden Vanguard
description: Finish at least 10 badges from the Gold tier.

name: Gol D. Kid
description: Finish all four paths in the Gold tier.

name: Five Million Club
description: Reach a cumulative transaction volume of $5,000,000.

name: Protocol Pillar
description: Maintain a total supply value of at least $100,000 for 30 consecutive days.

name: Eight Figure Club
description: Reach a cumulative transaction volume of $10,000,000.

name: Omnichain Presence
description: Have active supply positions of at least $300 on both Monad mainnet and BSC mainnet simultaneously for at least 72 hours.

name: Superhighway
description: Achieve a cumulative cross-chain transaction volume of $250,000.

name: Round Tripper
description: In a single 48-hour period: Supply on Chain A, use that to borrow on Chain B, bridge the borrowed assets to Chain C, and then use assets from Chain C to repay the loan on Chain B.

name: Active Citizen
description: Perform at least one on-chain transaction (supply, borrow, etc.) for 30 consecutive days.

name: For the People
description: Reach a cumulative transaction volume of $10,000,000. (Placeholder, as there's a duplicate description with the same points reward but different name).

name: Platinum Centurion
description: Finish at 5 badges from the Platinum tier.

name: Master of Platinum
description: Finish all three paths in the Platinum tier.

name: Citadel of Capital
description: Maintain a total supply value of over $500,000 for 30 consecutive days.

name: Twenty-Five Million Club
description: Reach a cumulative transaction volume of $25,000,000.

name: A Season of Mastery
description: Achieve all required conditions within the season: complete 'Twenty-Five Million Club', at least one other Diamond sub-tier, maintain an active supply position for all 90 days of the season.

name: Diamond Demi-God
description: Finish at least two badges from the Diamond tier.

name: Master of Diamond
description: Finish all four paths in the Diamond tier.

name: Yield Master
description: Achieve an effective APY of 20% or higher on your portfolio.

name: Achievement Hunter
description: Earn 20 achievements of any tier.

name: Gold Collector
description: Earn 3 gold-tier achievements.
